title: Extension pack configuration, version 1
description: extension.pack.json: what the tool's pack command puts in a package (contract §11.3). Paths are relative to this file. The tool always copies extension.json, generates extension.package.json, leaves out .git, .vs, obj, node_modules/.cache, *.user and pairing files, and refuses links and pairing files among the staged files.

readme.description: The file copied to README.md, which people read before installing.

strings.description: A folder whose *.json files are copied to strings/.

build.description: A dotnet publish step that runs first; its output is copied to payload/<to>/.

to.description: The folder under payload/. Default: companion.

payload.description: Copy rules, applied in order after the build step.

to.description: The folder under payload/ the files go to; "" for payload/ itself.

include.description: Globs of the files to copy from a folder (*, ** and ?). Default: ["**/*"].

exclude.description: Globs of the files to leave out. Default: [].
